Peppa Pig is a British preschool animated television series by Astley Baker Davies. The show follows Peppa, an anthropomorphic female piglet, and her family, as well as her peers portrayed as other animals. The show first aired on 31 May 2004. The seventh season began broadcasting on 5 March 2021. Peppa Pig has been broadcast in over 180 countries.[1]
Peppa herself has been voiced by several different performers through the years. Lily Snowden-Fine provided her voice in season one and Cecily Bloom in season two, then Harley Bird, five years old when she started, acquired the role for thirteen years until stepping down after season six.[2] She was replaced by Amelie Bea Smith. John Sparkes, Morwenna Banks, Richard Ridings, Oliver May and Alice May also provide voices.

Triceratops (/traɪˈsɛrətɒps/ try-SERR-ə-tops;[1] lit. 'three-horned face') is a genus of chasmosaurine ceratopsian dinosaur that lived during the late Maastrichtian age of the Late Cretaceous period, about 68 to 66 million years ago in what is now western North America. Fossils of the genus have been found in the western United States and in Portugal, where they are found in Kimmeridgian- to Tithonian-aged strata, dating to between 155 and 145 million years ago. description_text:
Fishing rod 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 5092 vertices, 4980 quad faces (9960 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Red blood cells (RBCs), also referred to as red cells, red blood corpuscles, haematids, erythroid cells or erythrocytes (from Greek erythros for “red” and kytos for “hollow vessel”, with -cyte translated as “cell” in modern usage), are the most common type of blood cell and the vertebrate’s principal means of delivering oxygen (O2) to the body tissues—via blood flow through the circulatory system. RBCs take up oxygen in the lungs, or gills of fish, and release it into tissues while squeezing through the body’s capillaries.
The cytoplasm of erythrocytes is rich in hemoglobin, an iron-containing biomolecule that can bind oxygen and is responsible for the red color of the cells and the blood. The cell membrane is composed of proteins and lipids, and this structure provides properties essential for physiological cell function such as deformability and stability while traversing the circulatory system and specifically the capillary network.

description_text:
Treble hook (triple fishing hook) 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 16620 vertices, 16620 quad faces (33240 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
High-quality PBR low-poly 3D model of Boat With Oars. It is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with all required PBR textures.
The model is built with great attention to detail and realistic proportions with correct geometry.
PBR texture sets are very detailed so it makes this model good enough for a close-up. 
Technical details:

  - 2 PBR textures sets.

  - 1821 Triangles.

  - 1763  Vertices.

  - Boat model is one mesh.

  - Oar model is one, separated mesh.

  - Model is completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied.

  - Pivot points are correctly placed to suit the optional animation process.

  - Model scaled to approximate real-world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials, and textures are appropriately named.

PBR Texture sets details:

  - 4096 Boat Main Body texture set  (Albedo, Metallic, Smoothness, Normal, Ambient Occlusion)

  - 1024 Oar object texture set  (Albedo, Metallic, Smoothness, Normal, Ambient Occlusion)

Available file formats:

  - 3ds Max 2016 (.max)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - Blender 2.82 (.blend | Cycles)

  - Unity3d 2017.3 (.unitypackage)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.glb)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

  - 3D Studio (.3ds)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - OBJ (.obj)

Follow Me!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Rescue3Dassets
Twitter: https://twitter.com/rescue3dassets
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/user/Rescue3DAssets
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rescue3dassets
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCCKuB8qTeRtiX0vye9qverw/
Website: https://www.rescue3d.com  
Additional Info:

  - To avoid misunderstandings this model is not intended for 3D printing.
It uses some low/mid-poly modeling tricks and is optimized for real-time and gaming apps and is an open mesh.
It is also intended primarily for rendering using various rendering engines (as Blender Cycles or Vray).

  - If you like this model and would like to make it printable please contact me first.
I'll try to make the model printable but I'll et you know if it is at all possible and what the differences will be.

  - If you are not sure about something in this 3D model then feel free to email me and ask before you buy.
I'll try try to reply as soon as possible and help you clear up any doubts. I can also send you some additional screenshots if you need.

The sockeye salmon (Oncorhynchus nerka), also called red salmon, kokanee salmon, or blueback salmon, is an anadromous species of salmon found in the Northern Pacific Ocean and rivers discharging into it. This species is a Pacific salmon that is primarily red in hue during spawning. They can grow up to 84 cm (2 ft 9 in) in length and weigh 2.3 to 7 kg (5–15 lb). Beetle Dining Chair 3d - Fully Upholstered
From the manufacturer :
The Beetle Chair has since its introduction in 2013 being well received by end-consumers as well as interior architects. Due to its appealing design, outstanding comfort and unique customisation possibilities, the chair can be seen in many of the most renown restaurants around the world. The wide range of upholstery options and different bases make it possible to put your personal touch to the chair and create one of its kind.

top_reviews:
[{"score": 1, "comment": "This was overall a good model, but it definitely wasn't built with FDM 3D printing in mind. I'm calling this a positive review because the model is great, but for users looking to 3D print this I'd call it negative. I had to do a lot of work on my end to make it work.

First and foremost the mesh files had a number of errors and at least Prusa Slicer couldn't auto correct them all. Notably with a naive slice attempt the built-in stands that look like they attach to the feet were clipped and the model wouldn't have been printable if I tried to proceed. It confused me for a long time until I imported the mesh into Fusion 360. That's when I saw that there were I think 4 distinct meshes represented by the file. The stands actually run inside of the feet, and the slicer wasn't able to reconcile this elegantly. I had to do the work to combine the meshes down to one in Fusion and then bring it over to the slicer to make it slice in a viable manner.

The two small wings in the back are extraordinarily thin and also need to be supported so it was very difficult to remove the supports without also clipping the wing. I actually broke off the rear left wing this way but thankfully I was able to just glue it back on successfully.

Also, the base has a very gentle slope which tends to pose challenges for slicers; for instance at the time of writing Prusa Slicer only just added some patches to better handle those slopes in their latest alpha release. When I printed this model those changes hadn't landed yet so the base was printed in an anomalous rough manner.

The good thing is that I printed in ABS so I was able to use ABS vapor smoothing to fix up a lot of the small imperfections like the rough base and the end result is good. It just took a lot of work to get there.", "date": "2023-03-10"}]

This is a low poly 3D model of a fly. The low poly fly was modeled and prepared for low-poly style renderings, background, general CG visualization presented as 1 mesh with quads only.

description_text:
Stylized Robot Mosquito model made in 3ds Max 2023 and textured in Substance Painter

  - Model pack contains .blend, .obj, .fbx and .max model files. Textures aren't embedded and have to be plugged in manually. One .max and one .fbx files contain simple vray embedded texture sets

  - Please note: The robot bottom is centered to 0,0,0 scene coordinates. Robot wasn't designed for rigging/animation, so some of its parts are centered to their geometry centers. Some pivots aren't alligned to geometry

  - Model has to be rescaled manually! Nothing is rigged, nothing is animated

  - Textures files include 4k reso Arnold, Corona, DocChan+norm+ao, PBR, UE4, Unity HD and Vray .png files

  - Textures are split into 3 sets - the robot body itself, glass elements and cameras. All sets are provided in 4k reso for the sake of rescaling

  - The device model is hollow

  - Most geometry consists of split parts

  - Glass elements on wings share same UV set

  - Graymat, partial topology and UV maps can be seen in screenshot section

  - Model is triangulated, has 60968 polygons and 31042 vertices

As usual - best wishes and have a great day!=)

description_text:
Step into the world of heroes with this Ant-Inspired Hero Figure 3D Model! This STL file is expertly designed for 3D printing enthusiasts and fans of miniaturized adventures. With intricate details and a dynamic pose, this figure is perfect for collectors, desk displays, or creative projects. Its high-quality design ensures an impressive final result.
Key Features:
Format: STL file, fully optimized for 3D printing.Compatibility: Compatible with most FDM and resin 3D printers.Unique Design: Features detailed armor, a powerful stance, and elements that highlight the character's essence.Recommended Print Settings:
Printer Type: FDM or resin.Layer Height: 0.1–0.2 mm for FDM; 50 microns for resin for high detail.Infill: 20–30% for stability.Supports: Required, especially for intricate parts like the helmet and limbs.Material: PLA or PETG for FDM; standard resin for SLA/DLP printers.Print Speed: 40–60 mm/s (FDM).Once printed, you can paint it to bring out its full heroic charm. Whether you’re a fan or just love detailed 3D models, this figure will be a standout addition to your collection!

description_text:
Stylized triton seashell 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons), no poles.
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.79 (Cycles materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles for Blender 3D 2.7x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.79)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.79 with Cycles materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons), no poles; 41303 vertices, 41268 quad faces (82536 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height);so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.79 + Cycles using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Jurassic Park, Velociraptor, dinosaur with a watchful pose Velociraptor dinosaur designed to a personal taste, it has thick skin texture and thin skin, the legs its texture is a little more detailed more in the nails simulating the tear.The velociraptor was divided into several parts since it was printed small and it is difficult to remove the supports, so I decided to cut it.The way of printing is in the photo as I place the body, the head is in the same way with the teeth up, and the arms are being printed with the nails up so that they do not use various supports.The photos of the other pieces are pending and I'm going to paint it so you can see the result, wait to see how it turns out.I remind you that it was divided into parts so that you can print it more reliably, and avoid mistakes and spoil material and the second reason is so that if you like it you can print it in a larger sizeThe size I decided on is 15 cm high but you can scale it to 200% or 300% or whatever size your 3d printer accepts.
The important parameters areQuality for the body and tail are 0.16 and the detail looks goodHead and arms 0.1 for better detailwalls 5top and bottom: 5support: tree personally is easier to take off from the connection points with the piece.speed: the slower the better between 30 and 40 but I tried 45 and it turned out greatadherence I always put 5 of edge so that it adheres better and I put a little hair spray just on the arms and tail, head.

description_text:
This set contains parts for building a squad of small alien brain bugs.They fit on 25mm bases.
Edit 2023-11-19 : added a version of the bodies with more clearance for the head socket
All the parts are poseable during assembly, to give it lots of different poses.
This set includes : 

  - 8 heads

  - 3 torso

  - 4 mechanical claw pose

  - 4 bio claw poses

  - 3 mechanical arm poses

  - 3 bio arm poses

  - 3 mechanical leg poses

  - 3 bio leg poses

  - 4 mechanical tail poses

  - 4 bio tail poses

  - 2 optional brain covers (can be printed in clear resin for a glass effect)

Warning : some parts are very thin and require caution when detaching from the supports. Overall the parts from this set are quite small.
Every part is included with both supported and non-supported versions for ease of printing. Every file is tested for resin printing. Test prints were done on Elegoo Mars2, with 0.05mm layer height, and 3 seconds exposure.

description_text:
This realistic screwdriver with a red transparent handle was created with Blender 2.73 and rendered in Cycles.
YOU WANT A LOW POLY GAME READY VERSION OF THIS MODEL? JUST LET ME KNOW!
|| GEOMETRY ||
Clean topology, only quads and tris. No ngons! Modifiers are not applied, so you still have full and easy geometry control.
Used modifiers:
  - subsurf - mirror - array
|| TEXTURES ||
This model uses only one noise texture image (jpg) at 640 x 640 pixels as bump and spec map for the screwdriver handle.
|| MATERIALS ||
4 materials created with nodes for Cycles Render.
|| COMPOSITING ||
Compositing setup to render the model isolated from the environment with alpha values as background included.
|| RENDERS ||
  - renders created in Cycles Render at 1.000 samples using subsurf modifier level 2 - wireframe renders are showing the mesh without subsurf modifier
|| SCALE ||
The model is in real world size and scale.
X = 0,036m (Blender units) Y = 0,301m (Blender units) Z = 0,036m (Blender units)
|| EXPORTED FILES ||
This model was created with Blender. Only the blend file includes materials, textures and modifiers. All other formats have been exported and including only the mesh!
|| END ||

description_text:
Design Harry Bertoia, 1952Welded steel rods, upholsteryMade in USA by KnollHarry Bertoia's 1950 experiment with bending metal rods into practical art produced a revered collection of seating, including the exquisite Bird chair. Innovative, comfortable and strikingly handsome, the chair's delicate appearance belies its strength and durability. In Bertoia's own words, 'If you look at these chairs, they are mainly made of air, like sculpture. Space passes right through them.'
Italian sculptor, university lecturer and furniture designer, Harry Bertoia was an inventor of form and an enricher of design. He introduced a new material by turning industrial wire rods into a design icon. Educated at the Detroit School of Arts & Crafts and Cranbrook Academy of Art. Bertoia taught metal crafts at Cranbrook while working with Charles Eames to develop his signature molded plywood chairs. Eero Saarinen commissioned him to design a metal sculptured screen for the General Motors Technical Center in Detroit. His awards include the craftsmanship medal from the American Institute of Architects, as well as AIA’s Gold Medal.
A classic, modern design that enhances any environment, Bertoia's Bird chair remains a fascinating study in bent metal and a fixture of mid-century design. Knoll is the only authorized and licensed manufacturer of the Bertoia Collection which has been in continuous production since 1952.

description_text:
The Firewatch Tower 3D model captures the essence of rustic charm and utilitarian design, standing tall against a backdrop of dense forests and sprawling landscapes. Constructed from weathered wood and sturdy metal, the tower features a multi-level design that showcases a watchful observation deck atop a robust framework. The exterior is adorned with subtle details, such as a weatherproof roof and large, reinforced windows that provide an unobstructed view of the surroundings, allowing for vigilant watch over the wilderness.
As you circle the model, you can appreciate the aged textures of the wood, flecked with patches of moss and signs of exposure to the elements, suggesting years of service in the great outdoors. The ladder, crafted with practical functionality in mind, allows access to the observation deck, which is complemented by a railing that encourages safe viewing of the expansive scenery. Surrounding the base of the tower, tufts of grass and scattered rocks reflect the natural environment, grounding the structure within its setting.
This 3D model not only serves as a striking visual centerpiece but also embodies the spirit of adventure and the vigilant duty of firewatchers, evoking a sense of nostalgia and a yearning for exploration in the wild. Whether for use in a game, simulation, or architectural visualization, the Firewatch Tower is designed to transport viewers to a time when nature and vigilance went hand in hand.

The Librarian of Unseen University is a character in Terry Pratchett's Discworld series of fantasy novels.
The Librarian is known for his violent reaction whenever he hears anyone refer to him as a monkey (orang-utans are apes). He speaks an elaborate language whose vocabulary consists of the single word Ook (and its antonym eek - where ook means yes, eek tends to mean no). Nonetheless, most people seem to be able to understand him. Both his language and his reaction were used separately and together as jokes in the first Discworld game.

description_text:
Coming from the shadows and crawling through every space are the Xenoteras Rippers (revisited). This new version of the Rippers gives you more to choose from and different positions, making them more dynamic and engaging.What you will see are 6 different poses: Crawling Pipe, Lurking Idle, Power Pose, Eating, Dodging and Running, all with and without Carapus. Each body have 6 slots that can be filled with Main Arms, Mid Arms and Talon Arms. The idea is that Main arms go on the front, Mid arms in the middle top, and Talons on the back, but they can be changed according to your taste. If you decide to do so, the Talons arms slot is a bit SMALLER, and the arms themselves too, so please take it in consideration when printing.
These models are design to fit on a 32mm base, but they could be scaled up if needed. The arms should be compatible with other miniatures (they are bulky and muscley, so maybe need to scale down a bit).You will notice that some of the poses come with a ROCK support, this is for making printing easier. If you want to place them on top of something different that's fine, there is a version without the rocks too.
Please note that this model is for personal use only. If you are interested on selling my models, please contact me privately
Also, you will find a CHITUBOX .ZIP file containing the supported projects for each of the files. They have been done with automatic supports and I can´t guarantee a succesful print, so if you are experienced with supports please check the projects beforehand.

description_text:
Pteranodon was a large, winged reptile that lived during the Late Cretaceous period, often mistaken for a dinosaur though it was a pterosaur. It had an impressive wingspan that could reach up to 33 feet (10 meters), allowing it to soar over ancient seas and landmasses. Pteranodon is best known for its distinctive, elongated crest at the back of its head, which likely played a role in balancing during flight or possibly in mating displays. Its beak was long and toothless, making it well-suited for catching fish, its primary food source.
With its lightweight body and hollow bones, Pteranodon was an expert glider, using thermal air currents to travel long distances with minimal effort. It is believed that Pteranodon spent much of its time near coastal regions, diving into the water to catch fish much like modern seabirds. Its sharp eyesight and keen hunting skills made it a highly efficient predator in its environment.
Pteranodon, like other pterosaurs, had membranous wings stretched between an extended fourth finger and its body, giving it an appearance quite distinct from modern birds or bats. Though not a dinosaur, it remains one of the most iconic prehistoric flying reptiles.

description_text:
Concept DesignThe 'That Crazy Dino Rabbit' merges playful dinosaur and rabbit elements to create a whimsical character. Its vibrant, multicolor attire and ecstatic pose deliver a sense of joy and surprise, aimed to delight viewers.
Intended UseIdeal gift for Easter and to celebrate new births! This model is an ideal design for decorative purposes, collectibles, or thematic decorations during festivities. It can also serve as a figure in themed board games or miniature setups.
Original idea: I was having dinner with my friends when we started remembering the animal-shaped pajamas we liked in high school and to celebrate graduations. When I got home I started sculpting a small decorative object for Easter and I thought of dressing up a cute t-rex with Easter bunny pajamas.
Print RecommendationsUse supports. No assembly required as this is a ready-to-print model with all elements integrated into a single piece.
Multicolor: The original sculpture was not designed for multicolor. The multicolor version is a rough and imprecise adaptation born at a later time, it is fine for small sizes but if printed in large sizes you will notice the triangles of the jagged edges that separate the colors from each other. The original version is monochrome, you can print it up to 4 colors if you prefer, I uploaded the file ready for printing.
My printing parameters:
with K1 Max, Creality Print and CR Hyper PLA:
Printing time: 1h49m.
Material Wt: 26.77g.
YES USE SUPPORTS.
No post production.
Speed: 300mm/s.
Infill density: 15% or less.
Layer: 0.1mm (or 0.2mm max)
Temp: 220°C.
Plate: 45°C.
Print & Sell
COMMERCIAL USE:
You can sell renders and 3D prints for commercial use.
You can't distribute the digital 3D model files.

description_text:
Low-poly historical accurate (as close as possible) reconstruction of a 17th-18th century farm from the pre-alpine Upper-Bavaria region in Germany in its original context / assembly. This one in particular was the ‘Hohenburg’ castle’s farm near the village of Lenggries as depicted in 1701. The buildings are made from plastered quarrystone and wood. The roofs are covered with wooden shingles.
The file includes:

  - The main building, the ‘Einfirsthof’ (one-ridge farm), which is typical for this region and time period. This building combines the living quarters in front and the stable and hayloft with an access ramp in the back.

  - A secondary building next to an artificial pond, dedicated to fish farming and fishing.

  - An additional smaller stable.

  - A little wooden barn.

Castle, trees, bushes and general scene are not included.
Bonus: original landscape plane (without texture and mapping)
Polys/Verts

  - Main farmhouse ‘Einfirsthof’ (15,035/27,689)

  - Outbuilding (5,851/11,085)

  - Stable (170/270)

  - Barn (98/142)

Further Information
Models are

  - fully mapped and textured with simple diffuse maps only.

  - collapsed to editable poly.

  - in real world scale.

description_text:
The nautilus (from Latin nautilus 'paper nautilus', from Ancient Greek ναυτίλος (nautílos) 'sailor') is a pelagic marine mollusc of the cephalopod family Nautilidae. The nautilus is the sole extant family of the superfamily Nautilaceae and of its smaller but near equal suborder, Nautilina.
It comprises six living species in two genera, the type of which is the genus Nautilus. Though it more specifically refers to species Nautilus pompilius, the name chambered nautilus is also used for any of the Nautilidae. All are protected under CITES Appendix II.[3] Depending on species, adult shell diameter is between 4 and 10 inches.
Nautilidae, both extant and extinct, are characterized by involute or more or less convolute shells that are generally smooth, with compressed or depressed whorl sections, straight to sinuous sutures, and a tubular, generally central siphuncle.[4] Having survived relatively unchanged for hundreds of millions of years, nautiluses represent the only living members of the subclass nautiloidea, and are often considered living fossils.

description_text:
+++++++++++++++BEFORE YOU MAKE PURCHASE:

  - My models are built on sizes and images from the internet. Therefore it will not be absolutely accurate compared to the real model.

  - If you cannot find the format that you need, contact me before purchasing or reviewing the product. I will assist you, including the refunds.

  - For formats where the model is not subdivision yet, don't worry, contact me and I'll help you with that. ( I will export and send to you high poly/ smooth version ).

  - Because of the different time zones, my response time is usually 12 hours. Please be patient. I will respond as quickly as possible.

+++++++++++++++Features:

  - High quality polygonal model. Mesh and details are built by our professional artists.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+++++++++++++++File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2018 + V-Ray ( 3.6 ) and standard materials scenes

  - OBJ 2018 (Multi Format)

  - 3DS 2018 (Multi Format)

  - FBX 2018 (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2018 with standard materials

  - Cinema 4D R20 with standard materials

  - Blender 2.91( If you need other formats or lower version please contact me, I will export and setup for you. )

+++++++++++++++Textures: ( just for the models have textures, some models have not textures because it just contain base material )

  - Models was textured will be seen in the preview image and the infobox next to it. Models have no texture just contain standard materials.For models have texture:

  - High resolution ( up to 4096x4096 pixels for big parts and 2048x2048 pixels for small parts ).

  - If you need 8K or higher texture, please contact me.

  - About UVs: Some models have no UV if it has no texture (it only materials have no texture ). If you need UV for the models please contact me and I will help you.

+++++++++++++++

  - NOTE for Cinima 4D users: add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - NOTE: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )If you can't extract file, please contact me and I will help you.

  - Also check out our other models, just click on my user name to see complete gallery.

The heart is a muscular organ in most animals. This organ pumps blood through the blood vessels of the circulatory system.[1] The pumped blood carries oxygen and nutrients to the body, while carrying metabolic waste such as carbon dioxide to the lungs.[2] In humans, the heart is approximately the size of a closed fist and is located between the lungs, in the middle compartment of the chest.[3]
In humans, other mammals, and birds, the heart is divided into four chambers: upper left and right atria and lower left and right ventricles.[4][5] Commonly the right atrium and ventricle are referred together as the right heart and their left counterparts as the left heart.[6] Fish, in contrast, have two chambers, an atrium and a ventricle, while most reptiles have three chambers.[5] In a healthy heart blood flows one way through the heart due to heart valves, which prevent backflow.[3] The heart is enclosed in a protective sac, the pericardium, which also contains a small amount of fluid. The wall of the heart is made up of three layers: epicardium, myocardium, and endocardium.

description_text:
Butterflies are insects in the macrolepidopteran clade Rhopalocera from the order Lepidoptera, which also includes moths. Adult butterflies have large, often brightly coloured wings, and conspicuous, fluttering flight. The group comprises the large superfamily Papilionoidea, which contains at least one former group, the skippers (formerly the superfamily "Hesperioidea") and the most recent analyses suggest it also contains the moth-butterflies (formerly the superfamily "Hedyloidea"). Butterfly fossils date to the Paleocene, which was about 56 million years ago.
Butterflies have the typical four-stage insect life cycle. Winged adults lay eggs on the food plant on which their larvae, known as caterpillars, will feed. The caterpillars grow, sometimes very rapidly, and when fully developed, pupate in a chrysalis. When metamorphosis is complete, the pupal skin splits, the adult insect climbs out, and after its wings have expanded and dried, it flies off. Some butterflies, especially in the tropics, have several generations in a year, while others have a single generation, and a few in cold locations may take several years to pass through their entire life cycle.

description_text:
A heretical tech priest model. A merging of three crazed tech worshipping heretics into a large centipede like machine.
The stls provided in this purchase are made up of of 3 individual sections, the legs/centipede area, the upper body and priests, and an axe. Provided as well is a single foundry base.
The model is very high detail, and spindly in some areas. I have personally gotten it to print well using chi-tu-box, but care must be taken when setting up and removing supports. Areas such as the individual dudes hands, and the centipedal legs are most likely to break. I reccommend placing very small, ~.4mm supports at these areas, and removing the majority of supports while the print is clean but uncured. Curing will harden the areas significantly, remvoing flexibility, but becoming difficult to break.
Any models shown were printed on an anycubic photon at the standard resolution.
I would love to know how your prints turn out, and about any problems you come accrossed.

The creature's sleek and menacing appearance makes it ideal for various applications, including sci-fi animations, game development, and VR/AR experiences.

Design: The creature's body is composed of a central core with eight long, articulated legs, each designed with intricate mechanical joints and segments. The overall design emphasizes a balance between agility and strength, with a focus on a realistic yet futuristic aesthetic.Textures: The model is textured with a combination of metallic and glossy materials, giving it a high-tech and polished look. The use of emissive textures adds an eerie glow to certain parts, enhancing its menacing presence.Materials: High-quality materials have been used to achieve a realistic appearance, including metals for the exoskeleton and reflective surfaces for the core and joints. The combination of matte and glossy finishes creates a visually striking contrast.Lighting: The creature is equipped with subtle red and orange LED lights along its legs and body, adding to its futuristic look and making it stand out in dark environments.Details: Each leg segment includes detailed mechanical components such as pistons, gears, and wiring, showcasing the complexity of its design. The central body features a dome-like structure with a translucent material, hinting at an inner power source or control unit.Rigging: The model is fully rigged with advanced controls for each leg and the central body, allowing for complex animations and dynamic poses.Polygons: The model is optimized with a moderate polygon count to ensure it is both detailed and efficient for rendering and real-time applications.Animations: Includes basic walking and idle animations to demonstrate the creature's movement capabilities. These animations can be further customized to suit specific project needs.Applications:
Animation: Perfect for sci-fi and horror animations requiring a realistic and menacing mechanical creature.Game Development: Ideal for use as a game asset in sci-fi or horror genres, adding depth and intrigue to the environment.VR/AR: Suitable for virtual and augmented reality applications, providing an immersive and interactive experience with a high level of detail.Concept Art: Useful for concept art and design visualization, helping artists and designers create compelling scenes and stories.File Information:
File Format: Blender (.blend)Textures Included: Yes (Diffuse, Specular, Emissive maps)Rigged: Yes (Advanced rigging)Polygon Count: Medium (optimized for detail and performance)UV Mapped: YesAnimations Included: Yes (Basic walking and idle animations)Instructions:To use this model, open the .blend file in Blender. All textures and materials are packed within the file, ensuring seamless loading. The rigging system allows for extensive pose and animation adjustments, making it easy to integrate the model into various projects. Customize the lighting and camera settings to achieve the desired visual effect. This Model has been created by taking inspiration and following the tutorial of polyjford. He is a popular and well  known blender creator on youtube , please do check him out.

A digital sculpture of 'Knight' a small insect knight with a broken sword and his characteristic blue cloak and 'Hornet' covered in his red cloak and with his needle to sew up his enemies. Straight out of 'Team Cherry' gaming masterpiece 'Hollow knight'. Includes two versions of the characters:

ESPAÑOL:

FRANÇAIS:
Une sculpture numérique de 'Knight' un petit chevalier insecte avec une épée cassée et son manteau bleu caractéristique et 'Hornet' recouvert de son manteau rouge et avec son aiguille pour recoudre ses ennemis. Tout droit sorti du chef-d'œuvre de jeu Team Cherry Hollow Knight. Comprend deux versions des personnages :
1- Imprimable : avec une approche plus dirigée de l'impression 3D, ce sont les deux personnages du jeu qui se tiennent la main alors qu'ils ont leurs armes caractéristiques2- Personnage : avec une approche majoritairement low poly et avec un rigg basique sur le mesh. Prêt à subdiviser.

description_text:
Stylized Mechanical Spider Robot model made in 3ds Max 2023 and textured in Substance Painter

  - Model pack contains .blend, .obj, .fbx and .max model files. Textures aren't embedded and have to be plugged in manually. One .max and one .fbx files contain simple arnold embedded texture sets

  - Please note: The robot bottom is centered to 0,0,0 scene coordinates. Robot wasn't designed for rigging/animation, so some of its parts are centered to their geometry centers. Most pivots aren't alligned to geometry

  - Model has to be rescaled manually! Nothing is rigged, nothing is animated

  - Textures files include 4k reso Arnold, Corona, DocChan+norm+ao, glTF, PBR, UE4 (jpeg, targa), Unity HD and Vray .png files

  - Textures are split into 2 sets - the robot body itself and the glass elements

  - The device model is hollow

  - Most geometry consists of split parts

  - Device model has no overlapping UV parts

  - Graymat, partial topology and UV maps can be seen in screenshot section

  - Model has 16673 polygons and 16107 vertices

As usual - best wishes and have a great day!=)

description_text:
Coronaviruses are a group of related RNA viruses that cause diseases in mammals and birds. In humans and birds, they cause respiratory tract infections that can range from mild to lethal. Mild illnesses in humans include some cases of the common cold (which is also caused by other viruses, predominantly rhinoviruses), while more lethal varieties can cause SARS, MERS and COVID-19, which is causing an ongoing pandemic. In cows and pigs they cause diarrhea, while in mice they cause hepatitis and encephalomyelitis.
Coronaviruses constitute the subfamily Orthocoronavirinae, in the family Coronaviridae, order Nidovirales and realm Riboviria.[3][4] They are enveloped viruses with a positive-sense single-stranded RNA genome and a nucleocapsid of helical symmetry.[5] The genome size of coronaviruses ranges from approximately 26 to 32 kilobases, one of the largest among RNA viruses.[6] They have characteristic club-shaped spikes that project from their surface, which in electron micrographs create an image reminiscent of the solar corona, from which their name derives.[7] 
The name coronavirus is derived from Latin corona, meaning crown or wreath, itself a borrowing from Greek κορώνη korṓnē, garland, wreath.[8][9] The name was coined by June Almeida and David Tyrrell who first observed and studied human coronaviruses.[10] The word was first used in print in 1968 by an informal group of virologists in the journal Nature to designate the new family of viruses.[7] The name refers to the characteristic appearance of virions (the infective form of the virus) by electron microscopy, which have a fringe of large, bulbous surface projections creating an image reminiscent of the solar corona or halo.[7][10] This morphology is created by the viral spike peplomers, which are proteins on the surface of the virus.[11]
The scientific name Coronavirus was accepted as a genus name by the International Committee for the Nomenclature of Viruses (later renamed International Committee on Taxonomy of Viruses) in 1971.[12] As the number of new species increased, the genus was split into four genera, namely Alphacoronavirus, Betacoronavirus, Deltacoronavirus, and Gammacoronavirus in 2009.[13] The common name coronavirus is used to refer to any member of the subfamily Orthocoronavirinae.[4] As of 2020, 45 species are officially recognised

The Los Angeles Rams are a professional American football team based in the Los Angeles metropolitan area. The franchise began in 1936 as the Cleveland Rams, based in Cleveland, Ohio. The club was owned by Homer Marshman and featured players such as William Bud Cooper, Harry The Horse Mattos, Stan Pincura, and Mike Sebastian.[8] Damon Buzz Wetzel joined as general manager.[9] The franchise relocated to Los Angeles in 1946 following the 1945 NFL Championship Game victory, making way for Paul Brown's Cleveland Browns of the All-America Football Conference and becoming the only NFL championship team to play the following season in another city. description_text:
The Wyvern Spine set *transforms the wearer’s back into a striking draconic silhouette. Inspired by the skeletal plates of wyverns and ancient flying beasts, these curved bone-like armor pieces line the spine with organic precision, *perfect for dark fantasy, dragon-themed, or necromancer costumes.
Each segment interlocks visually along the back, forming a realistic layered bone crest that adds depth and power to any armor build.
Measuring Instructions
To ensure a natural fit and alignment:
** Back Length:**
Measure from the base of your neck to your lower back (where your spine curves inward).
This distance defines the vertical span of the spine plates.
Width Adjustment:
The side “rib” pieces should slightly curve toward the shoulder blades — you can scale the width proportionally in your slicer if you want a broader or narrower fit.
Fit Tip:Print at 45–50 cm scale for adult human cosplay (fits an average torso height). For smaller builds or miniatures, scale uniformly.You can also gently heat and bend the parts (with a hairdryer or heat gun on low) to follow your back’s curve for a seamless anatomical look.
Printing Instructions
Supports: Minimal; only under deep curves
Layer height: 0.12–0.2 mm
Infill: 10–15 %
Material: PLA+, PETG, or resin for fine detail
Assembly: Attach with flexible harness straps, magnets, or directly to a backplate using epoxy
Each bone section is separate, allowing modular placement or custom spacing along the spine.
Finishing Tips
Prime in matte black and dry-brush with ivory or bone tones for realistic aged bone.
Add mossy green, blood red, or metallic bronze highlights for themed variants (e.g., forest dragon, undead wyvern, infernal drake).
Seal with matte varnish for an organic finish or gloss for a polished “armor-bone” aesthetic.
Model Type Recommendations
Perfect for:
Cosplay armor customization
Dark fantasy or dragon-themed costumes
Action figures and miniature creatures
Fantasy display busts or dioramas
Creature design prototypes

ENGLISH:Pokémon ornament for Christmas tree, Charmander model.
Charmander is a Fire-type Pokémon introduced in the first generation. It is one of the starter Pokémon that trainers starting their adventure in the Kanto region can choose, along with Bulbasaur and Squirtle.
Charmander is a small, bipedal, dinosaur like Pokémon. Most of its body is colored orange, while its underbelly is a light yellow color. Charmander, along with all of its evolved forms, has a flame that is constantly burning on the end of its tail. The intensity with which it burns is an indicator of the physical and emotional state of this Pokémon. When the intensity of the flame is low, your health may be at risk. When burning normally, Charmander is healthy and cheerful. When his tail flame burns brighter, it's because he's angry, and if his tail flame turns blue, it's because he found a strong and worthy rival. If the flame disappears or goes out, I would die

Charmander es un pequeño lagarto bípedo. Sus características de fuego son resaltadas por su color de piel anaranjado y su cola con la punta envuelta en llamas. Charmander, como sus evoluciones Charmeleon y Charizard, tiene una pequeña llama en la punta de su cola. La intensidad con la que esta arde es un indicador del estado físico y emocional de este Pokémon. Cuando la intensidad de la llama está baja, su salud puede estar en riesgo. Cuando arde con normalidad, Charmander está saludable y alegre. Cuando la llama de su cola arde con más intensidad, es porque está enfadado, y si la llama de su cola se vuelve azul es porque encontró un rival fuerte y digno de él. Si la llama desaparece o se apaga, moriría.

description_text:
ENGLISH:
ORNAMENTAL CUBONE HALLOWEEN EDITION.
Cubone (Japanese: カラカラ Karakara) is a Ground-type Pokémon introduced in Generation I.
Cubone is a small, bipedal, dinosaur-like reptilian Pokémon with a light brown hide that covers most of its body, except for its cream-colored belly.
It is called the Lonely Pokémon because of its tendency to keep to itself and avoid social situations, due to the trauma caused by the death of its mother. Cubone will often weep at night in mourning of its mother. When Cubone cries, the skull that it wears on its head vibrates and emits a plaintive and mournful sound. On the night of a full moon, the cries are said to be especially terrible. Cubone seems to recognize its mother in the full moon, and so it howls with a particular sadness. Its cries attract Mandibuzz, a natural predator. It is said a Cubone will evolve into a Marowak once it comes terms with its mother's death. The dreams Cubone have make it cry, but crying makes it stronger. Cubone lives in rocky areas, usually on mountains or in caves. It also once inhabited the Pokémon Tower in Lavender Town where deceased Pokémon were buried and mourned.

CUBONE ORNAMENTAL EDICIÓN HALLOWEEN.
Cubone (japonés: カラカラ Karakara) es un Pokémon de tipo Tierra introducido en la Generación I.
Cubone es un Pokémon reptil pequeño, bípedo, parecido a un dinosaurio, con una piel de color marrón claro que cubre la mayor parte de su cuerpo, excepto su vientre de color crema.
Se le llama Pokémon Solitario por su tendencia a encerrarse en sí mismo y evitar situaciones sociales, debido al trauma que le provocó la muerte de su madre. Cubone suele llorar por la noche de luto por su madre. Cuando Cubone llora, la calavera que lleva en la cabeza vibra y emite un sonido lastimero y lúgubre. Se dice que en las noches de luna llena los gritos son especialmente terribles. Cubone parece reconocer a su madre en la luna llena, por lo que aúlla con una tristeza particular. Sus gritos atraen a Mandibuzz, un depredador natural. Se dice que un Cubone evolucionará a un Marowak una vez que acepte la muerte de su madre. Los sueños que tiene Cubone lo hacen llorar, pero llorar lo hace más fuerte. Cubone vive en zonas rocosas, normalmente en montañas o en cuevas. También habitó una vez la Torre Pokémon en Lavender Town, donde se enterraba y lloraba a los Pokémon fallecidos.
Z: 150mm.

This miniature is designed to be printed and used in the Chibi Legends game (Spanish rule book included).
Your days as an adventurer will end with one of these on your knee.
At an early age, Iador had already proven his worth as a hero of the Semprepirenis forest, which is why he was appointed royal guard and protector of the princess.  During the war against the gods, Semprepirenis was devastated and Iador was defeated. Filled with shame and hatred towards humanity he wandered with what was left of his people, protecting them as best he knew how.
Now that the seals have been opened, the goddess Gaea has invoked him once more to regain the glory he lost and restore the power of the forests.

Ahora que los sellos se han abierto la diosa Gea lo ha invocado una vez mas para que recupere la gloria que perdió y restaure el poder de los bosques.

description_text:
Based on the mechanical owl featured in the 1981 Clash of the Titans,** Bubo has been remodeled and redesigned to allow for easy printing and full articulation of major body parts. ** Wings, legs, talons, and head can be posed. Most of the body parts have been designed to easily snap together or can be bound together using the the custom bolts designed for the legs and torso, and by using m3 screws and nuts to more firmly bind jointed areas in the wings, legs, and feet. M3 screws are a perfect fit at default scale.  A version of the rear torso, with the tail attached, has been supplied as a print option. The tail is the only part not designed to snap into place or doesn't have a printable element to attach it.
The default height, once assembled, is approximately 150mm. If scaled up or down,  measure the screw holes and find the appropriate screw and nut size for the resized model..  All parts have been printed and tested using a resin printer, but should also work with a finely calibrated FDM. I've also printed it a half scale to ensure that the pivots can still snap together without breaking. There should be a few examples depicted in thet sample imagery attached to this posting.
Several of the attached images show early tests and a few of the initial structural designs created for the wing. The initial design only rotated on a single axis, but the current rotates up and down at elbow, while all other pivots allow the wing to folder and bend. This allows for more interesting poses, despite the limited range of rotation. 
Update 2026:
  - A new version of the head without the neck extension and some topology revisions maintains neck articulation to a lesser degree, but pushes the design closer to the original design.

description_text: Bubo is a polygon model based on the mechanical owl depicted in the original 1981 Clash of the Titans, produced by film legend, Ray Harryhaussen. While many of the physical details are true the original design, aspects of the wings and talons were redesigned to enhance the mechanical illusion and to optimize polygonal density. Also, instead of etched sheets of metal for the wing, stylized metallic feathers were created. Bubo is UV'd and was textured using procedural shaders and textures. Bubo is built to be smoothed for high resolution renders and to be rigged for animation.  This model was developed in 2011. The rigged version may be made available, if interest is shown.

description_text:
Enter Anurognathus ammoni, one of the tiniest pterosaur species that ever lived! I wanted to print a lifesize pterosaur for ages, so I know I kind of cheated by picking the smallest one, but it still works!
There's two versions for it: one lifesize version and one miniature version. I really wanted to have it in flight, as I've been planning on printing a lifesize version that I want to hang from the ceiling, but I also realised that wasn't the perfect pose for it as a mini. Kind of sad to make it just lie on its base, right? That's why I made it soar over a conveniently placed rock base.The model is also split up into chunks that will be easy to place on the buildplate of an FDM printer.You can opt to have the entire model split into parts (head, body, wings, rock if desired, make sure to print the left wing with pin if you want it to be sitting on the rock!), creature split from rock (anurognathus model and rock separate) or as a full model (everything merged together! description_text:
UPDATE 1, 9th Aug 2018:Added a new substance containing a flat texture version of the Octopus, with all the original maps and customization, plus a height map to use for blending, parallax occlusion, tessellation, etc.
This will allow you to easily incorporate the design into other textures.A stylized Octopus sculpture for a variety of uses ranging from wall relief to decorative ornament.
Included are two meshes:
One sided relief version with 1322 Triangles and unique UVs.Closed, mirrored version  with 2644 Triangles and mirrored/overlapping UVs.
It comes with a  very customizable Substance featuring the base PBR channels, as well as several extra textures such as curvature, position, thickness and world space normals  in 2048 x 2048px size. Substance is supported natively or via free plug-ins in many programs and engines including Unreal Engine and Unity.
Also included:An authored linear greyscale material mask texture and a substance to isolate specific areas or a range of them.
A fully level-adjustable texture of hand-aligned gradients to expand the possibilities for texturing and masking.
3 substance presets to get you started with some variety right away.
Let me know if you have any questions or feedback please and I hope you enjoy my work!
Horst-Peter
